entities.summary: Brad McCormick Weber is a New Zealand rugby union player, who currently plays as a halfback for Mitsubishi Sagamihara DynaBoars in the Japan Rugby League One. He previously played for Hawke's Bay in the National Provincial Championship, the Chiefs in Super Rugby and for Stade Français in the French Top 14. He has represented New Zealand internationally.
